release_notes: One sale can take cash, M-Pesa, card, bank transfer, and a customer-credit remainder. Only confirmed payments count. A pending M-Pesa line is not collected. A return reduces the outstanding debt before any cash is refunded. A manager must enter the Super-Admin PIN before a void request changes the receipt. A signed-in Super Admin is not asked again. Dashboard profit uses the cost layers the sale consumed. A credit sale needs a customer. A zero quantity is refused. Includes the 3.1.73 inventory-value, product-removal, and startup fixes.
